description: Amentum Holdings is a global engineering and technology services company that was formed in 2020 as a spinout from AECOM’s Management Services group, giving it a heritage rooted in government services, operations, and technical support. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, the company serves U.S. government agencies, allied partners, and commercial customers with mission-critical solutions across defense, intelligence, space, nuclear, environmental, and infrastructure markets. The company’s modern form came together through a series of major portfolio moves. In  2024, Amentum was formed through the completion of a merger between the legacy Amentum business and a spin-off of the Jacobs Solutions Critical Mission Solutions business and portions of the Jacobs Divergent Solutions business.
